post-install-output: * Configure your database in <comment>.env.local</> (<comment>DATABASE_URL</>, MySQL / MariaDB or PostgreSQL)
* Create the tables with <comment>php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate</>
* Create a user with <comment>php bin/console cleverage:ui-process:user-create</>
* Install the assets with <comment>php bin/console assets:install</>
